decisions.reason: A cutting and creasing finisher close to the core portfolio, with its own page, fits the firm's established offer and gives no signal of a shortfall in a growing industry.
The UV spot varnishing system is distant from the core and its results are uncertain, but its prominent German premiere and the slack from industry growth let the firm carry it for now.
The sheet preparation module builds on established systems and supports the firm's modular automation direction, so there is no reason for problemistic search.
The B2 multifinisher was featured on the home page as a new flagship solution and is close to the core, so its results likely meet the aspiration.
The hybrid saddle stitcher sits squarely in the core booklet-making business with its own page and shows no sign of underperformance.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation that combines several steps in one pass, a satisfactory result that supports keeping it.
